name: Soldier
description: Combat and security personnel used for defense, breaching, and hostile-response roles.

name: Scout
description: Reconnaissance and exploration personnel suited to detection, route-finding, and early warning.

name: Technician
description: Hands-on systems personnel focused on building, testing, maintenance, repair, and machinery.

name: Scientist
description: Research and analysis personnel used for science rooms, discovery work, and alien phenomena.

name: Medic
description: Medical and recovery personnel focused on healing, treatment, and endurance support.

name: Diplomat
description: Social, trade, faction, and intelligence personnel used for negotiation and information work.
